taxonomy_fields.label: How would you describe your profession or current occupation?
Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
Is your employer based outside Spain?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires employees to work for a company located outside Spain.

taxonomy_fields.label: How many months have you worked for this employer?
taxonomy_fields.description: This employment relationship must have existed for at least 3 months.

taxonomy_fields.label: Has your employer authorized you to work remotely from Spain?
Has your employer's company been operating for at least 1 year?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the employer relied on for this application to show real and continuous activity for at least 1 year.

taxonomy_fields.label: Do you have a qualifying university, vocational-training, or business-school qualification, or at least 3 years of relevant professional experience?
taxonomy_fields.description: Verified requirement under Ley 14/2013, Art. 74 bis.2.

taxonomy_fields.label: What is your gross monthly salary in EUR before tax?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain DNV screening compares this to a threshold based on 200% of Spain's 2026 monthly minimum wage (SMI), plus additional amounts for each included dependent.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which employee documents can you provide as proof of salary?
For how many months can you prove this salary with those documents?
How many dependents are included in your application?
Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
What is your gross monthly freelance or contractor income in EUR before tax?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain DNV screening compares this to a threshold based on 200% of Spain's 2026 monthly minimum wage (SMI), plus additional amounts for each included dependent.

taxonomy_fields.label: Do you currently provide professional services to at least one client or company based outside Spain?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires self-employed applicants to have a professional relationship with at least one company located outside Spain.

taxonomy_fields.label: How many months have you worked with the foreign client or company you will use for this application?
taxonomy_fields.description: This professional relationship must have existed for at least 3 months.

taxonomy_fields.label: Can you perform your professional work remotely from Spain?
Has the foreign client or company you are relying on for this application been operating for at least 1 year?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the foreign client or company relied on for this application to show real and continuous activity for at least 1 year.

taxonomy_fields.label: Do you have a qualifying university, vocational-training, or business-school qualification, or at least 3 years of relevant professional experience?
taxonomy_fields.description: Verified requirement under Ley 14/2013, Art. 74 bis.2.

taxonomy_fields.label: Will any of your professional work be for clients or companies based in Spain?
What percentage of your total professional work will be for clients or companies based in Spain?
taxonomy_fields.description: Enter a number between 0 and 100. Spain allows up to 20% of your professional activity to be for Spain-based clients or companies.
